name: Malibu Original White Rum with Coconut Flavour
description: Malibu Original White Rum with Coconut is the perfect drink for when the sun is setting and the good times are flowing. Thanks to its smooth, fresh taste, that sun-kissed island feeling is only a sip away. Malibu rum has a full and rounded, lightly toasted coconut aroma, and a creamy coconut taste with vanilla custard notes. The body is delicate with a soft warming rum taste and a lasting silky finish.

name: Bumbu Original Rum
flavour_style: soft caramel Madagascar vanilla toasted oak cinnamon roasted nuts allspice
description:
BUMBU: Dating back to the 16th century, when sailors of the West Indies added Caribbean fruits and spices to their rum, calling it "Bumbu". Flagship Original Bumbu is blended from fine Barbados rum and hand-selected spices that evoke its rich and colorful history, revealing heritage and craftsmanship with every sip.

CARIBBEAN RUM: An authentic Caribbean legend, Bumbu is an exquisite all-natural craft rum made with native ingredients and aged for up to 15 years to create an effortlessly smooth and balanced rum with complexity and depth. Bumbu uses the finest sugarcane from sustainable farms throughout the Caribbean and South America.

TASTING NOTES: On the nose, Bumbu offers complex aromas of soft caramel, Madagascar vanilla and toasted oak The palate is medium bodied with notes of cinnamon, roasted nuts and allspice, leading up to a slightly sweet, smooth finish.

name: Bacardi Carta Blanca Superior White Rum 1L
description: BACARDÍ Carta Blanca Superior white rum is aged in American white oak barrels and shaped through charcoal for a distinctive smoothness, making it perfect for classic rum cocktails. This light, aged rum offers a smooth and creamy taste.

name: Kraken Black Spiced Rum
description:
The Kraken is imported Caribbean rum blended with spices, caramel and other natural flavours.
Named for the sea beast of myth and legend, The Kraken is bold, rich, black and smooth.
The largest shipment of Caribbean black spiced rum was said to be brought down by the Kraken.
The rum was named in its honour, as it was as dark and mysterious as the beast's ink.
The Kraken is housed in a replica of a Victorian flagon, which allowed the bottle to be hung up on board ships so it would not roll around and come to harm.

Tasting Notes
Appearance - Black, opaque.
Aroma - Caramel, toffee, spice.
Flavour - Cinnamon, vanilla, nutmeg.
Finish - A spicy and lingering finish.

name: Captain Morgan Spiced Gold 0.0% Alcohol Free Spirit
description: Introducing Captain Morgan Spiced Gold 0.0% Alcohol Free Spirit. Enjoy an irresistible spiced flavour and smooth taste of Captain Morgan Original Spiced Gold, without the alcohol. Experience the versatility when it comes to mixing your favourite cocktails and enjoy the luscious notes of caramel, molasses, vanilla and warm brown spices. Best enjoyed mixed with cola in a glass with ice and lime for a smooth, refreshing taste.

name: The Kraken Black Cherry & Madagascan Vanilla Rum
description: A fruity and flavourful fusion of our signature Black Spiced Caribbean Rum with rich black cherries and an undercurrent of smooth Madagascan vanilla.

name: Dead Man's Finger Golden Spiced Rum 70CL
flavour_style: sweet creamy vanilla cinnamon and fresh lime
description:
This Golden Spiced is a blend of the finest rum with flavours including sweet creamy vanilla, cinnamon and fresh lime.
Enjoy it mixed with cola, lemonade or ginger beer. Either way, this is not your usual this is Cornish Soul.

name: Havana Club 7 Year Old Dark Rum
flavour_style: aromatic tobacco, sweet tropical fruits, molasses, spices, and vanilla
description:
Havana Club 7 Year Old perfectly demonstrates the versatility of high- quality Cuban rum, as well as the deep commitment and expertise of our Rum Masters with the complex ageing process.

Crafted for sipping, to be enjoyed on the rocks and ideal for rich cocktails: Havana Club 7 Year Old is highly versatile. This dark rum, matured in ex-Bourbon barrels, showcases the rich natural flavours of Cuba. The liquid unveils the tastes of the Cuban terroir: aromatic tobacco, sweet tropical fruits, molasses, spices, and vanilla from the continuous ageing process, enhanced by the slow release of aromas.

Packaging May Vary

name: Mount Gay Eclipse Barbados Golden Rum 70CL
flavour_style: fresh vanilla, almond, ripe banana and dark chocolate
description: Mount Gay Eclipse Barbados golden rum is distilled in traditional copper pot and column stills, then matured in ex-American whiskey casks. Eclipse is the embodiment of the Mount Gay style with notes of fresh vanilla, almond, ripe banana and dark chocolate, perfect for cocktails

name: Woods Old Navy Rum
flavour_style: smooth dark rum with punchy notes of brown sugar and thick toffee
description:
Wood's Navy Rum
Wood's Navy Rum is a traditional British naval style rum, still bottled at 57% and made to the original navy recipe from 1887. The spirit is made from Demerara molasses and contains three different rums, all distilled at the Diamond Distillery in Guyana, South America, before being shipped to the UK. One of these rums is distilled in the 250-year old Versailles still; the only single wooden pot still in the world. The spirits are then aged in Scotland in American refilled oak barrels for an average of 3 years, before being blended and made into Wood's Navy Rum.

Wood's is the only Demerara navy rum still bottled at 57% ABV, the original strength served on British Navy ships.
Made using traditional pot stills, it is a smooth dark rum with punchy notes of brown sugar and thick toffee.

name: Lamb's White Rum
description:
The hexagonal bottle of Lamb’s is vastly different from any other rum bottle across the globe.

Legend has it that Alfred used the same bottle shape we have today for his rum because it wouldn’t roll off the table on a ship and it could be stacked on its side for storage.

As you raise your glass, be transported to the heart of the high seas. Notes of vanilla and molasses dance upon your palate, while whispers of green banana and vanilla bean awaken your senses, leading to a clean, crisp finish that leaves you craving more.

Whether you're crafting a classic mojito or indulging in a tropical piña colada, Lamb’s White Rum is your faithful companion for any adventure.

name: Wray & Nephew Overproof White Rum
description:
Wray & Nephew White Overproof Rum is the original rum of the Jamaican people and it has been distilled and bottled there for nearly 200 years.
More than just a rum, it is an intrinsic part of Jamaican culture, tradition and everyday living, and in the UK it represents the proud, bold spirit of the island and its people.

Characterised by citrus, pear and pineapple notes with a long and spicy finish, it is a very versatile liquid.

name: Kraken Dark Caramel & Sea Salt Spiced Rum
flavour_style: toasted toffee aroma buttery vanilla finish
description:
Our signature Black Spiced Caribbean Rum infused with dark caramel and Cornish sea salt

A rich Infusion of Black Spiced Caribbean Rum, dark caramel and a hint of Cornish sea salt. Plunge into an alluring toasted toffee aroma and a buttery vanilla finish.

name: Havana Club Especial Cuban Rum 70cl
description: The natural ageing process in young oak barrels in Cuba for a number of years gives Havana Club Añejo Especial its warm amber colour and smooth taste. Aged in this way, it develops a typical touch of vanilla that is perfect for mixing with cola or just with ice. The best way to savour this special rum is in typical Cuban style - together with your best friends.

name: Lamb's Black Spiced Rum 70CL
description:
Lamb's Black Spiced Rum is a meticulously crafted, luxurious blend of flavours and aromas designed to captivate your senses.

With a rich coffee hue and hints of dark burgundy, this medium bodied rum offers a delightful sweetness and a harmonious palate of bakers cocoa, brown sugar, and allspice cake, with a long and lingering finish.

name: Admiral's Old J Cherry Spiced Rum
Jura Rum Cask Scotch Whisky
description:
Jura's Cask Editions range is the perfect introduction to our whisky, showcasing cask types from around the world that complement our fruity and balanced style.
Jura Caribbean Rum Cask is finished in select Caribbean rum casks for a smooth, creamy and fruity finish. With layers of tropical fruit, sweet citrus and a hint of vanilla spice.

name: Captain Morgan Spiced Gold Rum Based Spirit Drink   1L
description: The original. The icon. It's Captain Morgan Original Spiced Gold, a spiced rum-based spirit drink flavoured with the taste of vanilla, other natural flavours and spice for an irresistibly sweet yet subtly spiced taste. Versatility is its speciality. Make it hot, make it cold, make it sweet, make it fruity or even make it creamy. Delicious possibilities are there for the making.
